| Guarded on-device agent runner | Cloud-tested only; no recorded Frame run | Fixed Tier A task runner, fail-closed PreToolUse guard and settings template tested in the cloud only; the Phase 0 installer's path, verify, signature, smoke and record stages tested in the cloud with a fake `claude` (the signature stage with locally generated keys and a fake download; precheck, install and the interactive login untested); none of the runner, guard, settings or installer has a recorded Frame run, and the review's cycle-3 follow-ups are open; [E77](#e77-claude-code-on-frame-runner-guard-and-installer-cloud-checks) |
| Dedicated Arcturus Vulkan capture | Upstream-reported | Community implementation reviewed; no Framejacker deployment or device capture result |
| Built-in passthrough camera input | Unverified | Upstream reports empty built-in-camera-sized buffers; no source-identified built-in-camera frames have been received |
| Stereo depth and world-space labels | Deferred | Calibration, depth and pose/timebase alignment remain unresolved |
| Gaussian splat reconstruction and viewing | Deferred optional work | Recorded-data workflow researched; training and headset splat rendering not validated by this project |

Implemented tooling, offline checks, CI, device reports and upstream claims
are separate evidence. Process reaping and successful API cleanup do not
establish physical headset recovery. Production live HUD gates remain closed.

## Maintaining the evidence

The coordinator allocates the next unused evidence ID and adds its record
and metadata to `docs/evidence/index.json`. Record execution date, platform,
runtime, revision, procedure, observations and limits; mark unavailable fields
unknown. Update reviewed capabilities in `docs/status-data.json`, then run:

```bash
python3 scripts/generate_status.py
python3 scripts/generate_status.py --check
```

The generator updates this file and the marked architecture progress block.
[Live capture](live-capture.md) owns next tasks; the
[documentation plan](documentation-plan.md) owns maintenance conventions.
